Storefront and customer routes of the promotions module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## POST /v1/promotions/automatic

Get automatic promotions

Request body: [GetAutomaticPromotionsDto](#getautomaticpromotionsdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Promotions retrieved.

## POST /v1/promotions/validate-coupon

Validate coupon code

Request body: [ValidateCouponDto](#validatecoupondto).

Responses:

- `200`: Coupon validated.
- `400`: Invalid coupon.

## Schemas

### CartItemDto

- `productId` (string, required).
- `categoryId` (string, required).
- `quantity` (number, min 1, required).
- `unitPrice` (number, min 0, required).

### GetAutomaticPromotionsDto

- `subtotal` (number, min 0, required).
- `items` (array of [CartItemDto](#cartitemdto), required).
- `userId` (string, optional).

### ValidateCouponDto

- `code` (string, required).
- `subtotal` (number, min 0, required).
- `items` (array of [CartItemDto](#cartitemdto), required).
- `userId` (string, optional).
